pattern: Serial accumulate chain over many products
strategy: Rebalance into a tree of parallel additions
rationale: Serial chain creates 11 stages of full-width carry propagation. A balanced tree groups 12 products into 6 parallel pairs, then recursively combines them in 4 levels instead of 11—same result in bounded 2's-complement arithmetic (associative modulo 2^40), but depth falls from O(n) to O(log n).
target: soc_bench.v:254-265 (sys_s array and g_sys_add generate block replaced with tree computation)
area_cost: none — tree uses the same operators, just reordered
equivalence_argument: Both serial and tree add all 12 sign-extended products. Addition is associative modulo 2^40 in 2's-complement arithmetic, so (a+b)+c = a+(b+c) in fixed width. The final sum sys_sum_final equals sys_s[11] bit-for-bit. Saturation is applied identically afterward. Reset handled by sys_acc_p register, unchanged.
